upstream_frozen.module_3_coarse_input: P_coarse and M_coarse=(P_coarse>=0.50) shared across all variants

deformable_geometry.zero_shift_exact_preservation: (a, b) == (0, 0) keeps exact original M_coarse pixels without redrawing

gradient_scoring_and_dp.outward_semantic_guard: mean_{x in A_i^+(a,b)} P_coarse(x) >= p_floor (support LOO q25 clamped [0.20, 0.48]; k=1 conservative forbid outward)
gradient_scoring_and_dp.support_null_threshold: tau_grad = Q_0.95 of support pure-block null-movement DP gain per unit arc

stage_0_offline_geometry_audit.offline_gt_reachable_reference: compare M_coarse vs old rigid shift vs new deformable path using identical GT pixel utility U_i(a,b) (not strict BF1 upper bound; GT never enters inference)
